The structure of U2Hg8Au4 (reduced formula UHg4Au2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/ncm (No. 143), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Au and Hg centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors, while U centers show 16 neighbors; these environments span neighbor distances of roughly 2.68–3.51 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Hg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Au-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
